subject: BlueQuill — throughput & error-rate regression following modelpack v4.1q rollout
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice@bluequill.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@bluequill.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden p95/p99 latency and 500s after v4.1q deploy

Maya,

We're seeing a substantial degradation in our inference SLA since the v4.1q modelpack went live on our Redwood Dedicated pool last night (around 02:30 AM UTC). Key symptoms:
- p95 latency up ~3x, p99 up ~4.5x on the hot routes;
- a ~1.2% increase in 5xx responses across the last 3 hours;
- throughput for our steady-state batch flattened despite normal traffic.

We attached a short trace and a histogram (p99) — the log shows a cluster of "kernel-timeout" and increased decode stalls. This rollout was the quantized profile you recommended (v4.1q-int8alpha). The customer-facing impact is visible in transaction timeouts and two escalations from their support.

Can you confirm whether Redwood rolled any kernel/encode changes with that profile? We need an initial triage and a rollback contingency within the day — the customer is asking for an executive contact.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Technical Program Manager, BlueQuill Financial

Attachments: bq_error_sample_0507.log, p99_histogram_0507.png
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 latency and 500s after v4.1q deploy

Alice — thanks for the prompt details and the attachments. I’m escalating immediately. Initial notes:
- I see the traces and p99 histogram shared (linking to internal drive for full logs).
- We shipped v4.1q to your dedicated pool last night as part of the scheduled maintenance window (quant profile optimized for token throughput). No kernel-level driver changes were deployed for your region at the same time.

Action we’ll take in the next 60–90 mins:
1) Run a fast rollback of the quant profile to v4.1 (non-quant) on a canary subset to validate latency deltas.
2) Collect a combined trace (runtime + decode) and run a targeted profiler to isolate whether the decode stage or KV eviction is spiking.
3) If rollback looks good, we will apply to your primary pool with a brief canary followed by cut-over.

Marissa / Vivek — assigning this to ops; please coordinate rollbacks and prep an exec summary for Irene and Rishi. Alice — can you share the HubSpot deal ID and confirm whether any rate limit changes happened on your side in the past 24 hours?

I’ll update by 10:30am PDT with the canary results.

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: BlueQuill — throughput & error-rate regression following modelpack v4.1q rollout — Exec summary + action items

Team — forwarding the thread and attaching the canary telemetry and profiler snapshot. Summary for execs: 
- Incident: p95/p99 latency and elevated 5xx observed after deployment of v4.1q (int8 quant profile) to BlueQuill Dedicated pool.
- Impact: customer-facing timeouts and merchant failures; SEV declared by BlueQuill; negative business impact during peak window.
- Root-cause (preliminary): quant profile triggers decode-stage stalls at high-concurrency hot paths — profiler shows increased kernel decode time on specific attention kernels for sequences >512 tokens. No infra driver updates coincided with the rollout.
- Immediate remediation taken: 5% canary rollback at 10:00 PDT (p95 down ~35%), staged to full rollback by 10:26 PDT after verification. Full rollback completed by 11:00 PDT; customer telemetry returned to baseline within ~22 minutes.
- Open asks:
  1) Platform: run a focused test matrix for v4.1q across sequence lengths and concurrency profiles and provide a deterministic mitigation (hotpath patch or alternate qprofile).
  2) Sales/CS: coordinate credits/financial remediation language for Mark (suggested initial credit: one month of reserved capacity pro-rata while we resolve root cause).
  3) Engineering leadership: decision on pause of further quant-profile rollouts until we validate kernel/caching interaction.

Attachments: bq_error_sample_0507.log, p99_histogram_0507.png, request_trace_20270512.txt
